description: A club's weekly newsletter sent from its own server: text/plain only, 8bit UTF-8; Precedence: bulk; List-Unsubscribe with a mailto URI whose percent-encoded subject is the one to send; a story unsubscribed by e-mail
raw:
Return-Path: <club-news-bounces@club.example.net>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 18:05:00 +0100
From: Hiking Club <news@club.example.net>
To: alice@example.com
Subject: Weekend walks, 21-22 March
Message-ID: <weekly-2026-12@club.example.net>
Precedence: bulk
List-Unsubscribe: <mailto:leave@club.example.net?subject=unsubscribe%20weekly>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Weekend walks, 21–22 March

Saturday: Ridge path, 14 km, meet 9:00 at the station.
Sunday: River loop, 8 km, meet 10:30 at the bridge.

Bring water and a rain jacket.

Hiking Club
To stop this weekly mail, reply with "unsubscribe" or write to
leave@club.example.net.
